name: heading
label: Heading
help_text: Use the rich text toolbar's Heading options (H2/H3/H4) to set the semantic level. Typography always comes from the R2 Design System for whichever level is chosen.

name: intro
label: Intro
default: Practical solutions designed to help your team work smarter and move forward.

name: accent_phrase
label: Accent phrase
help_text: Optional. Rendered below the heading/intro. Leave empty to render nothing. Bold text automatically uses the R2 Caveat script treatment, e.g. twelve advantages, one program ↓

name: show_numbers
label: Show Numbers
help_text: Toggles the numbered dot/index shown above each card's title.

name: benefits
label: Benefits
help_text: Each benefit is automatically numbered in the order shown here.
